full_judgment:
Mustafa Kamal , J. : The appeal by leave by defendant Nos. 1 and 2 is from the first appellate judgment and decree dated 23-8-88 passed by the High Court Division, Barisal Bench in First Appeal No.123 of 1980 allowing the appeal in part and modifying the decree dated 29-4-90 in Title Suit No. 90 of 1972 passed by the learned Subordinate Judge Patuakhali. 

 4. The trial Court decreed the suit on the ground that the will Ext. B is not effective because a Burmese Buddhist cannot make a will. It cannot also be considered as a family arrangement because in accordance with Burmese Buddhist Law a family arrangement can only be made amongst the heirs. The appellants and other defendants not being heirs to the properties left by Thanchanio Talukder the will cannot also be considered as a family arrangement. With regard to the award of Bisudhananda Mahathero the trial Court held that the original award was not forthcoming and its alleged copy cannot be taken into consideration. It is also' an unregistered document. Under section 49 of the Registration Act this instrument cannot extinguish the title of the 'plaintiff. The trial Court found that except for 6 acres of land described in Schedule Ka, item No.1, which were sold by the plaintiffs husband before his death, the plaintiff was entitled to a full decree in the suit. 

 The suit was accordingly decreed excepting 6 acres of land in item No. 1 of Schedule Ka land. The suit was also decreed in preliminary form in respect of those lands for which partition was sought. 

 5. On appeal by the appellant and defendant No. 2, the High Court Division fully concurred with the reasonings of the trial Court but allowed the appeal in part modifying the trial Court's decree insofar as the number of livestock in Schedule Kha and the amount of jewelry in schedule Ga are concerned and set aside the preliminary decree for partition of item Nos. 2-8 of Schedule Ka land.
